sentences.text: New India Assurance Co. Ltd vs Heirs Of Decd.Prajapati

D  
 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/FIRST APPEAL NO. 3285 of 2025  ==============================================
 NEW INDIA ASSURANCE CO. LTD.
 Versus  HEIRS OF DECD.PRAJAPATI FENILKUMAR VALJIBHAI PRAJAPATI  VALJIBHAI JETHABHAI & ORS.
 ==============================================
 Appearance:
 MR RITURAJ M MEENA(3224) for the Appellant(s) No. 1  LEEN K DAVE(9559) for the Defendant(s) No. 5  MR MAYUR RAJGURU(1198) for the Defendant(s) No. 1  NOTICE SERVED for the Defendant(s) No. 2,3,4  ==============================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HASMUKH D. SUTHAR  Date : 05/02/2026  ORAL ORDER 1) Insurance Company is in First Appeal under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
Challenge is made to the judgment and award dated 27.03.2025 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Main), Visnagar in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.45 of 2018.

sentences.text: 2) Perusal of the judgment and award indicates that Insurance Company has challenged the judgment and award made to the tune of Rs.4,25,000/- to the victim of the road accident.
3) Heard learned advocates for the respective parties.

4) Since the amount involved in the First Appeal is small and meagre, paying due regard to smallness of amount, this Court is of the considered view that the First Appeal should be disposed of as compensation awarded seems to be just and reasonable and no interference is called.
It is hereby New India Assurance Co. Ltd vs Heirs Of Decd.Prajapati Fenilkumar ...

sentences.text:
on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134107967/
1 made clear that this First Appeal is disposed of only on the ground of award of compensation being meager and small.

This Court has not expressed any opinion on NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3285/2025 ORDER DATED: 05/02/2026 undefined merits and question of law raised in this First Appeal and is kept open to be urged in other proceedings which may arise from the same road accident / same judgment and award.

It is made clear that this order will not come in the way of adjudication of any other First Appeal pending against same judgment and award or adjudication of any other claim petition arising from same road accident.

Since the First Appeal is disposed of only on the contention of monetary value, principle of res judicata shall not be applied to any other proceedings arising from the same road accident or same judgment and award.
5) In view of above, the First Appeal is dismissed.
Pending Civil Applications, if any, stands disposed of as having become infructuous.
6) Record and Proceedings and amount, if any lying before this Court is ordered to be transmitted to the concerned Tribunal forthwith along with accrued interest, if any.

The entire awarded amount be disbursed and released in favour of the claimants after due verification by transferring the said amount to the account of the claimants either by RTGS or NEFT mode.
(HASMUKH D. SUTHAR,J) ANKIT JANSARI New India Assurance Co. Ltd vs Heirs Of Decd.Prajapati Fenilkumar ... on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134107967/
